subject: Approved guide for the Dreamrules ruleset

before.name: Choose an enemy traitor
before.text: Choose traitors before dealing starting Treachery Cards. You cannot keep your own leader as your traitor. If all four choices belong to you, reveal them and everyone redraws. For Harkonnen's extra redraw options, see p17.

after.name: Choose an enemy traitor
after.text: Choose traitors before dealing starting Treachery Cards. You cannot keep your own leader as your traitor. If all four choices belong to you, reveal them and everyone redraws. For Harkonnen's extra redraw options, see page 17.

before.name: Atreides can create another mine
before.text: Atreides can create a mine with its Fate, see page 16.

after.text: Atreides can create a mine with its Fate, see page 16.

before.note: Count strongholds and any token or Shield Wall contribution still in effect after resolving a tie.

after.note: Count the token point and Shield Wall here too, unless you left them out to break a tie.

before.name: Version
before.text: Local review draft, 27 October 2026. Covers the eight finished factions.

after.name: Version
after.text: 27 October 2026. Covers the eight finished factions.
